rules.title: San Francisco Rent Board allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, as published by the Rent Board.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance's annual allowable increase limits.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37)
rules.conflict_note: Page gives rate only; coverage cutoffs and specific section not stated in this document. Prior rates: 1.4% (2025-26), 1.7% (2024-25).

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits at the Rent Board rate, which is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: Security deposits held for San Francisco rental units subject to the deposit interest requirement.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board security deposit interest rate (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 49)
rules.conflict_note: Document does not give the governing ordinance citation; ch. 49 citation not stated in document. Prior rates: 5.0% (2025-26), 5.2% (2024-25).

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work (20+ days), or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation of $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children, for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.key_value: $8,245/tenant; max $24,733/unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies terminated in San Francisco on the listed no-fault grounds, with notice served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 instead.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to evictions on specified no-fault grounds; amounts depend on date of service of eviction notice and tenant age/disability/household status.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting under the Ellis Act must pay $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant, for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05/tenant; max $33,330.13/unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from rental market) in San Francisco.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to Ellis Act evictions; amount depends on date of service of eviction notice and tenant age/disability.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.conflict_note: Section number inferred from form label '578 Multilingual Relocation Payments 37.9A'.

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement of less than 20 days
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days, landlords must pay $446.00 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses, for notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
rules.key_value: $446.00/day per household plus actual moving expenses
rules.coverage_conditions: San Francisco tenant households temporarily displaced for capital improvement work for less than 20 days.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to temporary displacements of less than 20 days for capital improvement work.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.conflict_note: State statute applied in San Francisco; daily rate published by SF Rent Board. Prior rate $436.00/day (2025-26).
